Gets all predefined ADP App Protection controls for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/inspectionControls/predefined/adp

Gets all predefined ADP App Protection controls for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
version
string

The predefined control version.

search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
controlGroup
string

The control group.

defaultGroup
boolean

Indicates whether or not the controlGroup is a part of the mandatory controls group. This is only used by the ZPA Admin Portal.

predefinedInspectionControls
InspectionPredefinedControl[]
]
